policy.purpose: literature-derived experimental localization benchmark after adsorption-label-free parameter selection
policy.prediction_ordering: predictions are generated and saved before experimental localization annotations are loaded for comparison
policy.primary_inclusion: folded proteins interacting with real material interfaces for which the original study reports protein-side localization that can be mapped to the analyzed structure
policy.secondary_inclusion: direct protein-side localization is available, but adsorption-associated structural change or structural-model limitations make static native-state comparison more demanding

cases.evidence: Limited proteolysis plus mass spectrometry identified Domain II as the silica-associated region.
cases.journal: Journal of Colloid and Interface Science
cases.notes: The reported Domain II annotation is interpreted as regional evidence.

cases.evidence: Covalent capture coupled with MALDI-MS identified three HSA peptide regions proximal to PAA-coated Fe3O4 nanoparticles.
cases.notes: The comparison uses the reported pH 6.2 capture condition and the PDB structure mapped in the experimental study.

cases.evidence: Site-directed fluorescence localized the silica-facing region around residue 10 at pH 6.3.
cases.notes: Residue 10 is treated as an experimental anchor rather than a complete atomistic contact set.

cases.evidence: Site-directed fluorescence implicated the region around residue 37 at the higher-pH condition.
cases.notes: Residue 37 is treated as an experimental anchor rather than a complete atomistic contact set.

cases.evidence: Solution NMR localized the gold-nanoparticle interaction site to the Q2-I3 and L15-E18 surface regions.
cases.notes: The reported NMR-localized residue ranges are used directly.

cases.evidence: 15N NMR chemical-shift perturbations localized preferential interaction with MPA-coated gold nanoparticles to the reported residue set.
cases.notes: The MPA-coated condition is used because beta2-microglobulin remained suitable for native-state structural comparison.

cases.evidence: Solid-state NMR identified the largest adsorption-associated perturbations in the Ala250-Lys310 surface region while the tetramer remained folded.
cases.notes: The experimental study used PDB 3ECA. Equivalent-subunit scoring accepts the reported residue-number region on any symmetry-equivalent chain.

cases.evidence: Limited proteolysis plus LC-MS/MS showed decreased accessibility in residues 140-160 and 480-500 after adsorption to polystyrene nanoparticles.
cases.notes: Presented as a secondary challenge because adsorption-associated structural effects and the available structural model make static folded-state comparison more demanding.

cases.evidence: Limited proteolysis plus LC-MS/MS showed decreased accessibility in residues 350-380 after adsorption to polystyrene nanoparticles.
cases.notes: Presented as a secondary challenge because adsorption also produced broader structural and activity changes. Equivalent-subunit scoring is used for the tetramer.
